# DATAVERSITY

> DATAVERSITY is the premier platform for data management training, professional certifications (CDMP and ADGP), and industry conferences connecting data governance leaders worldwide.

DATAVERSITY offers expert-led certification programs, major conferences like Enterprise Data World (EDW) and Data Governance & Information Quality (DGIQ), and comprehensive resources for data professionals seeking career advancement and practical education in data management disciplines.

## Key Topics

- CDMP Certification
- Applied Data Governance Practitioner (ADGP)
- Data Governance
- Enterprise Data World (EDW)
- Data Management
- Information Quality
- Data Architecture
- Professional Development
- Data Education
- Certifications
- Metadata Management
- AI Governance
- Career Advancement
- Women in Data Management
- Webinars

## Certifications & Training

- [CDMP Certification Training](https://www.dataversity.net/cdmp-certification): CDMP expert-led training and certification exam preparation
- [Applied Data Governance Practitioner (ADGP) Certification](https://www.dataversity.net/applied-data-governance-practitioner-adgp-certification): ADGP certification training for data governance practitioners

## Events & Conferences

- [Data Management Events & Conferences](https://www.dataversity.net/events): DGIQ and EDW conferences, webinars, and demo days
- [2026 Data Governance & Information Quality (DGIQ) West + Enterprise Data World (EDW) Conference](https://dgiq-edw2026.dataversity.net): 2026 DGIQ West + EDW conference in San Diego with certifications
- [2026 DGIQ + EDW Conference Registration](https://dgiq-edw2026.dataversity.net/registration-welcome.cfm): 2026 DGIQ + EDW conference registration and pricing

## Educational Resources

- [Data Management Resources](https://www.dataversity.net/resources): Resource hub with podcasts, white papers, webinars, and articles
- [Data-Ed Webinar: Data Strategy – Where Data Architecture and Data Governance Collide](https://www.dataversity.net/webinar/oct-14-data-ed-webinar-data-strategy-where-data-architecture-and-data-governance-collide): Webinar on aligning data architecture and governance with Peter Aiken
- [Cutting Through the Noise: What AI Governance Leaders Really Need to Know](https://www.dataversity.net/webinar/cutting-through-the-noise-what-ai-governance-leaders-really-need-to-know): AI governance webinar covering responsible and explainable AI
